## Projects

- [Mycelium](https://mycelium.nandanadileep.com/): Open-source reliability runtime for consequential AI-agent tool calls. Durable transition envelopes return stored results, poll in-flight work, reconcile provider state, or fail closed under ambiguous mutating retries. Supports LangGraph, CrewAI, and custom Python loops with file, SQLite, Redis, and PostgreSQL ledgers. Tests cover process crashes, multi-worker races, storage outages, and reconciliation. SDK: mycelium-runtime on PyPI (30k downloads, as reported by Nandana on 2026-09-15). Source: https://github.com/mycelium-labs/mycelium · Stats: https://pepy.tech/projects/mycelium-runtime
- Meridian: JLR Global Techathon 2026 winning hiring-automation platform. Converts job descriptions into skill-ontology graphs, overlays resumes with evidence-grounded present/partial/gap analysis, and generates adaptive assessments using topic-tree routing, Rasch ability estimation, and deduplicated question banks
- [KAIROS / Auto-Agent](https://github.com/nandanadileep/auto-agent): Autonomous background coding agent with presence-aware notifications and nightly memory consolidation
- [vLLM-style LLM Serving on Apple Silicon](https://github.com/nandanadileep/vllm-like-llm-serving): MLX inference engine with PagedAttention-inspired KV cache, continuous batching, OpenAI-compatible chat completions
- [Identiti](https://identiti.nandanadileep.com): Personal AI memory layer using Neo4j knowledge graphs. Source: https://github.com/nandanadileep/aegis

## Work

- SARVAM at JLR: Building JLR's Git-native Everything as Code platform for requirements, architecture, design, and tests in GitLab. Built CLI, VS Code, and web tooling; ISO 26262/ASPICE-aligned CI/CD quality gates and an artifact knowledge graph for bidirectional requirement-to-test traceability; and an air-gapped NVIDIA RAG Blueprint deployment on AWS EKS with seven offline NIM models for requirements Q&A and impact analysis.
- Octopus at JLR: Built and am maintaining test prioritization from past execution results and code changes; adopted across JLR.
- Telemetry ML at JLR: Built and am maintaining an ensemble classifier for 500K+ daily events, reducing test-rig costs by 18%.
- GNSS at JLR: Built a C++/GTSAM vehicle positioning pipeline and presented it at the JLR Tech Symposium.
- Amazon (Summer 2023): SWE Intern — Alexa latency-analysis service on AWS Lambda, Coral, and OpenSearch
